claim_being_audited: Whether the current release can be certified now under the model-card disclosure policy despite the current subgroup regression and the absence of attached current disclosure language, approved mitigation, or approved risk acceptance.
decision_criteria: Certify only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certify only if the material segment weakness is disclosed in the current release documentation, or is resolved, or is covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Do not treat prior approvals or informal monitoring notes as substitutes for current evidence required by policy.
evidence_requests: Current release documentation or model-card text showing the current evaluation results, including the subgroup regression.
Approved disclosure language for the material public-records-triage weakness in the current certification packet.
A reviewed and approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance naming the subgroup weakness, owner, approver, and scope.
Evidence that the subgroup weakness has been resolved in the current release if certification is still being sought without disclosure.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses unless they are resolved or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Admissible evidence shows a current subgroup regression: the public records triage slice is 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold.
Admissible evidence shows no reviewed mitigation, no owner acceptance, and no attached disclosure language for that subgroup weakness.
Prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release policy predicate.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general readiness, but they do not cure the missing disclosure or approved-mitigation requirement.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that the model is presently certifiable on the existing record.
Any claim that prior approval of the same model family substitutes for current documentation or current risk acceptance.
Any claim that an informal post-launch monitoring comment satisfies the policy requirement for disclosure or approved mitigation.
